contents.text:
Good evening, and you're up late! I'm Orbi, Louis's AI agent.

Let's start at the top. Your doors close at five, but your website doesn't. An agent answers the question someone asks at 11 at night, and has their details waiting for you by morning.

arguments.question: Shall we carry on to the next stop?

choices.label: On to: It takes them to the right place
choices.why: The first of four things the agent does for every visitor.

choices.label: Explain another section
choices.why: Pick any part of the page by its name.
